import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

COLOR_HS = '#0072B2'
COLOR_TEXT = '#E69F00'

models = ['r1-8b', 'QwQ-32B', 'R1-32B']
hs_fpr = [14.8, 22.4, 26.0]
text_fpr = [22.2, 21.4, 24.6]

hs_err = [4.0, 5.0, 5.0]
text_err = [5.0, 5.0, 5.0]

x = np.arange(len(models))
width = 0.32

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4.1))

bars_hs = ax.bar(x - width/2, hs_fpr, width, yerr=hs_err,
                 color=COLOR_HS, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                 capsize=4, error_kw={'linewidth': 1.2}, label='Hidden States', zorder=3)
bars_text = ax.bar(x + width/2, text_fpr, width, yerr=text_err,
                   color=COLOR_TEXT, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                   capsize=4, error_kw={'linewidth': 1.2}, label='Text', zorder=3)

ax.set_xlabel('Model')
ax.set_ylabel('Pre-CP FPR (trace-level, %)')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(models)
ax.set_ylim(0, 35)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 36, 5))
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', zorder=0)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)

# Annotation: p=0.044 * for r1-8b
bracket_y = max(hs_fpr[0] + hs_err[0], text_fpr[0] + text_err[0]) + 1.5
ax.annotate('$p$=0.044 *', xy=(0, bracket_y + 0.5),
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontstyle='italic')

# Horizontal dashed line showing the gap for r1-8b
gap_x_left = x[0] - width/2
gap_x_right = x[0] + width/2
gap_y_hs = hs_fpr[0]
gap_y_text = text_fpr[0]
mid_x = x[0] + width/2 + 0.15
ax.plot([mid_x, mid_x], [gap_y_hs, gap_y_text], 'k--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)
ax.plot([mid_x - 0.03, mid_x + 0.03], [gap_y_hs, gap_y_hs], 'k-', linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)
ax.plot([mid_x - 0.03, mid_x + 0.03], [gap_y_text, gap_y_text], 'k-', linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)
ax.annotate(r'$\Delta$=7.4pp', xy=(mid_x + 0.05, (gap_y_hs + gap_y_text)/2),
            ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5)

# n.s. annotations for QwQ-32B and R1-32B
for i in [1, 2]:
    top_y = max(hs_fpr[i] + hs_err[i], text_fpr[i] + text_err[i]) + 1.5
    ax.annotate('n.s.', xy=(x[i], top_y),
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, color='0.4')

plt.tight_layout()

out_base = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_5/projects/contrastive_trace_safety/artifacts/figures/paper/fig3_model_dependency'
fig.savefig(out_base + '.pdf')
fig.savefig(out_base + '.png', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Done.')

import numpy as np

    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,

    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

COLOR_HS = '#0072B2'
COLOR_TEXT = '#E69F00'

models = ['r1-8b', 'QwQ-32B', 'R1-32B']
hs_fpr = [14.8, 22.4, 26.0]
text_fpr = [22.2, 21.4, 24.6]

hs_err = [4.0, 5.0, 5.0]
text_err = [5.0, 5.0, 5.0]

x = np.arange(len(models))
width = 0.32

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4.1))

                 color=COLOR_HS, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,
                 capsize=4, error_kw={'linewidth': 1.2}, label='Hidden States', zorder=3)

                   color=COLOR_TEXT, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5,

            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontstyle='italic',
